text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x was published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x was translated from y.
House(y) ::: y is a publishing house.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → House(y)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are published by a house.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → InLanguage(x, english)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies was published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
PublishedBy(harryPotter, newVesselPress) ::: Harry Potter was published by New Vessel Press.
